commentary: Jason's read on Zuck's 6,500-word essay is dead-on: the 'abundance' framing is really a pitch to voters to keep approving data centers. Smart PR, and it'll probably work.
Kofi's floating-SMR pitch is the most practical answer to the AI power crunch I've heard on TWIST — put the reactor on a barge at the port and skip the interconnect queue entirely.
The whole Airtable story in one exchange: $400M ARR means nothing to an acquirer without growth. The multiple follows the growth rate — hence the 81% haircut.
